mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO kd_inventory (material_id, material_number, material_name, spec_model, stock_id, stock_name, unit_name, qty, valid_qty, available_out_qty, category_id, category_name, category_sort, image_url, sync_time) VALUES
(#{it.materialId}, #{it.materialNumber}, #{it.materialName}, #{it.specModel}, #{it.stockId}, #{it.stockName}, #{it.unitName}, #{it.qty}, #{it.validQty}, #{it.availableOutQty}, #{it.categoryId}, #{it.categoryName}, #{it.categorySort}, #{it.imageUrl}, #{it.syncTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE material_number = VALUES(material_number), material_name = VALUES(material_name), spec_model = VALUES(spec_model), stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), unit_name = VALUES(unit_name), qty = VALUES(qty), valid_qty = VALUES(valid_qty), available_out_qty = VALUES(available_out_qty), category_id = VALUES(category_id), category_name = VALUES(category_name), category_sort = VALUES(category_sort), image_url = VALUES(image_url), sync_time = VALUES(sync_time)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category_id FROM kd_inventory WHERE category_id IS NOT NULL AND category_id != ''

SELECT category_id, category_name, MIN(category_sort) AS category_sort FROM kd_inventory WHERE category_id IS NOT NULL AND category_id != '' GROUP BY category_id, category_name ORDER BY MIN(category_sort), category_name
